At any step the admin may cancel: no request is sent.
The same 401 and 403 answers apply to every
mutating request below unless stated otherwise.
Admin enters name, cpuCores, ramBytes and gpuCount
and commits Create New Compute Group.
Admin selects an existing group, edits CPU, RAM
